# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- The user expects implementation to align exactly with the prompt they provide, not just approximately or with inferred substitutions.
- At the start of every session, read what `docs/ai/copilot-instructions.md` §0 lists, in full, before any other work, and the rest of the rule files before the work they cover (§0's table).
- Repository-specific Markdown guidance files should be treated as binding rules when applicable, with `docs/ai/copilot-instructions.md` serving as the central index/reference for those rules.
- Treat files with "deprecated" in their filenames as historical reference only, not as current instructions.

## Implementation Process
- Gaps are tracked as GitHub issues with the label `gap` (title `G-nn — <title>`). Refer to a gap by its `G-nn`, and check GitHub before saying one is still open.

## Terminal Commands
- If a terminal command is cancelled or hangs, check whether it already took effect, then move on.
